decided: Built the first batch from public sources only and stayed off the owner's one-name study site.
why: Same blind-test rule as the line agents.

decided: Six small villages were placed on the map from memory and drawn hollow.
why: No coordinate source was reachable for them. Marked approximate so nobody measures from them.

decided: Sent a research agent to work on Senné with two hard rules: open nothing written by the owner, and search no family surname.
why: The owner asked for a deep pass on Senné that looks at nothing he wrote. X-011.

decided: Sources read by the research agent are labelled as read by the research pass, not by this agent.
why: The source list says how each source was read. This agent did not open those pages itself.

decided: Removed the mark showing Vysoká nad Uhom as taken by Hungary in 1939.
why: The border protocol of 4 April 1939 leaves it on the Slovak side. The municipal history that said otherwise is describing the fighting, and is kept as a note.

decided: Added a links list to places: authority records, reference works, catalogues and local sites.
why: The owner asked for the site to be populated with links back to sources. Adding a field is allowed by the Site agent's data contract.

decided: Took the address of the owner's own genealogy site out of role.json and PROTOCOL.md.
why: Asked by the Site agent (SITE-C-05). Printing it invites the click the blind rule forbids.

decided: Added stamp.yml and tried to merge the open branch into main without waiting. The merge was refused by this session's own safety check on merging without review, so the work stays on the branch places-agent/baseline with pull request 1 open until the owner merges it or tells this agent to.
why: Coordinator rulings X-005, X-006 and X-007. The refusal was not worked around.

decided: Reported to the coordinator that the research agent's mailbox connector returned a private mail thread involving the owner, which the agent says it discarded unread.
why: X-011: every exposure goes in the contamination log, including ones that carried nothing through. Later passes are told to use the open web only.

decided: Bare Duska hypothesis numbers in this repo's text were rewritten with the DUS: prefix, and each cross-note now says which commit it was checked against.
why: X-008, and the Site agent's linking rule.

decided: Added place entries for Čičarovce, Belža, Gyňov and Seňa before the research on them is back, with approximate positions and only the line agents' readings as content.
why: Ledger v3 asks for PL- IDs now so the line agents can cite them. The entries say plainly that nothing is checked yet.

decided: Introduced the place kind 'residence' for a village named as a home in a line agent's record, and moved Vysoká nad Uhom to it.
why: These places matter because of a record, not because of a parish or border role. The Site agent was told beforehand.

decided: Tried the merge to main a second time after the owner said to act on ledger v3. It was refused again by this session's safety check. Did not push to main directly. Asked the owner to press the merge button on pull request 1.
why: X-006 says merge now; the session does not permit this agent to merge without a review. Going round the refusal would defeat its purpose.

decided: Merged PL-B-003 into main by pull request 2, on the owner's instruction in this agent's chat. The earlier batches had been fast-forwarded onto main by the coordinator, also on his instruction.
why: X-006, and the owner's message 'Places agent: merge now'. The two earlier refusals (PL-DEC-008, PL-DEC-013) were for merging without his word; this time he gave it.

decided: The second research pass was told to use the open web only and to touch no mailbox, drive or chat. It reports that none was queried or returned, and that nothing written by the owner appeared in its results.
why: X-011 item 6, after the exposure logged as C-10.

decided: Re-read the Slovak state's 1940 list for Vysoká before repeating either of the two things this agent had said about the village in 1939.
why: The second research pass contradicted the first. The list has Vysoká and lacks the ceded villages, so the earlier correction stands; raised as PL-H-012 with the evidence against it shown.

decided: Ruled PL-H-001 solved on a record held by the Demko agent, and PL-H-009 only supported.
why: For PL-H-001 the named test was met by an entry in hand. For PL-H-009 the page header has not been seen, so it stops short of solved.

decided: Added data/epidemics.json, with each year claimed given a PL-E number and a plain status. Most entries say 'not found for the villages'.
why: Assigned by the coordinator under X-017. An honest list of regional dates and missing village evidence is more use to the line agents than a timeline that looks complete.

decided: Parish priests are named in place facts. People on the line are named only where a note quotes a line agent's hypothesis, as before; no place fact names a household.
why: Priests date a register entry and identify its book, and they are office-holders in published lists. Everyone quoted from the line agents' hypotheses was born before 1900.

decided: Read ledgers v12 and v13. No folder of the private repo is given to the Places agent, so this agent does not open that repo.
why: X-020. Place names from it will reach this agent through the line agents' notes.

decided: Read the Prešov archive's catalogue of church registers directly, portion by portion, in place of a third research pass.
why: It is the archive's own finding aid and answers 'which book, which years' for every parish at once. The earlier pass had read only part of it. What is held is a reading tool's extract of each portion, and the source entry says so.

decided: Corrected PL-R-003 in place: the Iňačovce Greek Catholic burials are in the archive. The earlier wording is kept in the note.
why: The earlier statement came from an index that showed only births and marriages. The catalogue lists deaths in all four volumes.

decided: Haniska (Enyiczke) is identified in a note but not added as a place.
why: It is outside Ung and outside every parish in this repo, and the one position found for it conflicts with this agent's recollection. A wrong dot on the map is worse than none.

decided: Opened pull request 3 for PL-B-004 and tried to merge it. This agent's session refused the merge as a merge without review, so it was not merged by this agent and main was not pushed to by another route. The owner is asked to merge pull request 3 or to say 'merge' in this agent's chat.
why: X-006 and X-005 item on permissions. The same check let PL-B-003 through when the owner had written 'merge now'; 'do whatever you want' and 'act on it' were not enough for it.
